messages:
sam: hi all, i'm sam, first day on runtime. following the README to build from source on ubuntu 22.04 with CUDA 12.2. build fails during link with an undefined cublasLt symbol. any onboarding tips? :wave:

ivy: welcome sam! quick checklist: `nvcc --version`, `nvidia-smi`, and `ldconfig -p | grep cublasLt`. are you using the NVIDIA runfile or distro packages?

sam: nvcc 12.2.148, nvidia-smi shows Driver 525.85.12. installed cuda via runfile to /usr/local/cuda-12.2. `ldconfig` points to /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12 as well as /usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64/libcublasLt.so.12. build tail:
```
/usr/bin/ld: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcublasLt.so.12: undefined reference to `cublasLtMatmulDescCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

ivy: sounds like host contamination: distro lib in /usr/lib is older ABI. two safe onboarding routes: 1) use our dev container `ghcr.io/redwood-inference/rt-dev:cuda12.2` (recommended), or 2) add rpath for local dev: `make LDFLAGS="-Wl,-rpath,/usr/local/cuda-12.2/lib64"` to force the correct cuda lib at runtime.

sam: i can't purge system packages on this laptop, so rpath sounds perfect. any docs on that?

ivy: docs/runtime/runtime-setup.md covers common host issues; i'll add a short note about using rpath and the dev image. open a tiny PR and tag me and infra. also run `gcc -Wl,-verbose` if rpath doesn't fix it to see exact search order.

infra-bot: Note: recommended onboarding image ghcr.io/redwood-inference/rt-dev:cuda12.2 available. Use to avoid host toolchain conflicts.

sam: thanks! i'll try the rpath trick and report back here. appreciate the quick help. :thumbsup:
